lines.zh: 长到腰际的金发拖在身后
lines.en: Golden hair drags to my waist behind me.

lines.zh: 没有眉毛的脸格外阴沉
lines.en: Browless, my face looks harsher.
Every step leaks a little of my ki.

lines.zh: 脚下的气把地面压出纹
lines.en: My aura presses cracks into the ground.
My shoulders have broadened a full size.
Walking slowly, rationing my strength.
My long hair sweeps sideways in the aura.

lines.zh: 空气被推开，走成一条道
lines.en: The air parts and I walk down the gap.
My face set, no spare words.

lines.zh: 这一步震得碎石跳起来
lines.en: This step bounces gravel off the ground.
My aura burns gold almost to white.
My stride is steady. My ki is not.
My long hair hangs perfectly still.
My aura surges in rising layers.
I stare at my own hand.
This form burns ki too fast.
The ground keeps trembling under me.
I don't have long. I know that.
Where eyebrows should be, there is nothing.

lines.zh: 长风把草吹成一片倒伏
lines.en: My aura bows the grass in one direction.
I compress my ki inward a little.
My eyes glow without warmth.
I grit my teeth and endure.
Just standing here costs me.
Ki crackles across my skin.
I can only walk this road so far.

lines.zh: 你离远点，我控制不住气
lines.en: Stay back. I can't fully hold my ki.
This form costs me dearly.
I slowly look down at you.
A small body can still hold full ki.
Your ki is far too faint.
I don't want to hurt you. Leave.
My eyes settle on you.
My aura pushes the stones around.
Is standing even hard for you?
Smaller now, but my ki is not.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
Time is passing. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你运气不错，我还没动手
lines.en: Lucky for you, I haven't moved yet.
Take this look as a warning.
I push my aura down an inch.

lines.zh: 你的影子被光照得发白
lines.en: The glow bleaches your shadow.
You'd better listen to what I say.
Now, step aside.
It hurts, but I can't stop.
My ki wavers, then I force it down.
That one landed hard.
I bite down harder.
Blood glues my long hair to my face.
I step back and plant my feet.
Another sliver of time gone.
I look up, my eyes empty of feeling.
My shoulder shakes. Not from fear.
Even this won't break me.
Hungry. This form burns more.
Eat, so my ki can recover.
Not enough. Truly not enough.
I smell it, and my eyes light up.
One bite and I leak a little less.
Don't just stand there. Hand it over.
I can't hold this form much longer.
Bring the whole pot. I'll take it.
Hot food restores ki best.
Once I eat, I can let this go.
My aura hits you before I do.
Not so close. The aura cuts.
I step back so I won't crush you.
You hit my shoulder like a wall.
Stand up. I don't want to steady you.
My aura shoves you back.
That much contact is nothing.
I look at you and say nothing.
Your hand is going numb.
Move along. That's all.
This form isn't for such things.
Someone brushes my long hair lightly.
I pull my aura in before coming close.

lines.zh: 能接下这一拳的人不多
lines.en: Few can take this fist.
Standing together matters most.
I say nothing. Just a nod.
What time I have, I give to you.
We fight again another day.
Don't be afraid of what I look like now.
I'll carry this road for us.
I grab it, sparks between my fingers.
It sears my palm for an instant.
I hold it carefully so it won't shatter.
Two weighs. Very light.
I stuff it in my gi and press it flat.
This form grips too hard.
One look, and I remember where it is.
Keep it. It'll be useful.
Picking it up is easier than talking.
I put it back down.
You've forced my hand.
I didn't want to use this level.
My aura shoots up past the treetops.
My long hair whips up in the surge.
I exhale a wave of hot air.
A ring of cracks spreads from my feet.

lines.zh: 眼睛不再是我原来的颜色
lines.en: My eyes are no longer their old color.
You shouldn't have seen this form.
Then let's end this quickly.
Every second drains me.
I'm done waiting.
My fist comes up.

lines.zh: 气把周围的石块全吹开
lines.en: My aura blows every stone clear.
Run, and it won't help.
This one, I won't hold back.
Right now, this instant.
No circling. I press straight in.
My aura has wrapped around you.
Even raising your arm is a struggle.
I'm counting what time I have left.
The cracks follow me as I move.

lines.zh: 你退得越快，我追得越紧
lines.en: The faster you retreat, the tighter I follow.
This won't hold much longer.
So I end it in one blow.
Your ki has curled into a knot.
Don't look into my eyes.
My long hair streams like a banner.
Two steps left.
You can't stop what comes next.
The ground shivers beneath me.
This is the last step.
I gather all my ki into my right fist.
Stay just like that.
Here comes the strike.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，地面塌了一块
lines.en: My punch caves in a slab of ground.
The shockwave knocks a tree down.

lines.zh: 这一下压在你的护肩上
lines.en: This blow lands on your pauldron.
The impact slides you backward.
I don't chase. I take one breath.
A knee follows the fist.
Ki bursts across my knuckles.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，整条手臂在抖
lines.en: You blocked it, and your whole arm shakes.

lines.zh: 这一下我只出了一半力
lines.en: That was only half my strength.
The fist stops. The ki doesn't.
The crater under you deepens.
It grazes your shoulder and tears cloth.
My long hair whips across your face.
I grit my teeth and rein the force in.
After this strike I have to fall back.
This is over.
The long hair lands first. Then me.
A ring of force flattens all the grass.
My aura pushes the clouds apart.
The ground sinks half a foot where I land.
My hair has grown impossibly long.
I touch where my brows should be.
This form didn't come easily.
Only a hum remains in the silence.
Heat radiates out from my feet.
I glance at the sky first.
This isn't my world.
My power is still climbing.
I need to finish this fast.
Every inch of me runs hot.
My long hair falls, and the lightning comes.
I straighten up, hair falling to my waist.
This form won't last.
Then we use it now.

lines.zh: 火焰被我的气顶开了些
lines.en: My aura pushes some of the flame aside.

lines.zh: 落地太猛，脚下的地碎了
lines.en: I land so hard the ground shatters.
Underwater my ki won't rise. It's stifling.
The blast slams into my aura.

lines.zh: 那东西在碰到我之前就慢了
lines.en: It slowed before it ever reached me.
This force is siphoning my ki.
Hunger makes even my hair feel heavy.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，和我身上的气打架
lines.en: Lightning strikes and fights the ki in me.
The void is draining my ki away.
